params.message:
Attio: the organisation a person gives, from billing details and the contact form

A new person field Gentells company holds the legal name from the billing details, or
the company typed on the contact form. Saving billing details records a customer.details
event; Attio gets the name on the person, on the company by domain when the address has
one, and a note with country and VAT number. The backfill gives organisations that saved
billing details earlier that event once.

Portal: Attio toont nu bij elke persoon de organisatie die ze opgaven, uit de factuurgegevens of het contactformulier.
